title: Packaging Materials Guide for Custom Boxes
excerpt: Understand paperboard, kraft, corrugated stock, rigid board and food-safe materials before choosing custom packaging.
coverAlt: Paperboard, corrugated board and tissue samples beside folding cartons (concept image)

sections.heading: Paperboard for retail boxes
sections.body: Paperboard is commonly used for folding cartons, cosmetic boxes, retail boxes and lightweight product packaging. It supports clean printing and professional finishing.

sections.heading: Kraft for natural packaging
sections.body: Kraft board gives a natural and eco-friendly look. It is useful for food brands, organic products, handmade items and sustainable packaging styles.

sections.heading: Corrugated board for protection
sections.body: Corrugated stock is used for mailer boxes, shipping boxes and ecommerce packaging where strength and product protection are important.

sections.heading: Rigid board for luxury packaging
sections.body: Rigid board is used for premium boxes, magnetic boxes, drawer boxes, gift boxes and luxury retail packaging where strong structure is required.

faqs.question: Which material is best for custom boxes?
faqs.answer: The best material depends on product weight, presentation, shipping method, printing quality and budget.

faqs.question: Is kraft material good for food packaging?
faqs.answer: Kraft can be suitable for many food packaging styles, but the final choice depends on food contact, grease resistance and coating requirements.
